items.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: The show was called “The Funny Side” on NBC. Gene Kelly was the host. A weekly comedy show. And my job was to write a production number each week.

ctx.x: The show was called “The Funny Side” on NBC. Gene Kelly was the host. A weekly comedy show. And my job was to write a production number each week. It had to last nearly five minutes and it had to involve up to twelve cast members. And the more cast members were involved, the better they liked it. So it was really strange songwriting. It was writing for groups of people, for two people here who would answer what two people over there did, and they would react lyrically according to some plot. Each week the song…
Did it ever irk you that you were writing things that probably were going to be used once? Or was it just the job?
